[[Daggers of the Hierophant]] are [[unique item|unique]] [[daggers]] obtained from the [[Hierophant's Chest]], which appears after defeating [[Duncan the Black]] in [[Slavers' Exile]].

== Stats ==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Energy]] gain on hit: 1
:[[Energy regeneration]]: -1
:[[Enchantments]] last 20% longer
